name: Raspberry Pi 4 Enclosure
description: A durable, well-ventilated case for Raspberry Pi 4, featuring cutouts for all ports and GPIO access.

name: Arduino Uno R3 Case
description: Compact Arduino Uno enclosure. Snaps together easily without the need for screws.

name: ESP32 Project Box
description: Weather-resistant box for ESP32 microcontroller with a transparent lid option.

name: PCB Standoff Assortment
description: A set of 50 precision-printed PCB standoffs in various lengths (5mm to 20mm). Do not step on it.

name: Soldering Helping Hands Base
description: Heavy weighted base for flexible soldering arms. Includes an unidirectional chip that allows the user to control the arms with their mind (experimental).

name: Cable Management Clips
description: Pack of 20 adhesive-backed or screw-mounted clips to keep your workbench wires organized and prevent strangulation.

name: Concrete Casting Mold - Planter
description: Reusable rigid printed mold for concrete planters. Please allow the concrete to harden BEFORE removing the mold.

name: Soap Mold - Fight Club
description: Single-piece mold for (we don't speak about it) soaps. Printed with skin-safe PETG.

name: Phone + Bluetooth Keyboard Case
description: Look like a sci-fi movie hacker with this phone case insert component for the modular cyberdeck which converts any smartphone into a clamshell palmtop.

name: Polymer Clay Cutters
description: Set of 5 diverse shape cutters for polymer clay jewelry making. You can also use it for cookies, just don't mix them!

name: Desk Organizer
description: A single-pieced desk organizer. Quickly discover when someone steals your pens by keeping them organized and in sight!

name: Headphone Stand
description: Sleek, minimalist headphone stand to keep your desk tidy and show off your gear.

name: Controller Mount
description: Keep your weapons loaded. Under-desk or wall mount for standard gaming controllers.

name: Articulated Axolotl Toy
description: Meet the Skeleton Axolotl, a creepy-cute articulated axolotl designed to wiggle, pose, and move straight from the build! Do not feed it with your fingers.

name: Battery Storage Dispenser
description: Gravity-fed AA and AAA battery dispenser. Keeps your batteries organized and accessible. Batteries not included.
